svg.title: The sweep of the old topics
svg.desc: On an instance that sets DONE_TOPIC_HOURS, the first run of the schedule of the new version notes when it ran, and the sweep starts the hours of the instance later. Each run of the schedule takes, as its last step, one page of 20 links of topics, at most ten deletions and three writes. A link that was done before the first run counts; any other stays. The record of its thing decides. A done thing that names the topic and has no done mark loses its topic as after a press of Delete topic, with one write. A thing that is gone, or names another topic, such as a release that moved on, loses nothing, and its old topic goes without a write. An open thing and a thing with its done mark stay. A refusal of Telegram ends the run, and after a day the sweep goes past that topic. Once the list is through, or 30 days after the first run, the sweep ends and costs nothing more.
